references.text: A similar concluding formula for the law concerning mildew in garments, which together with 14:54 forms a summary of the laws regarding tzara'at (leprosy).
The complete conclusion to the entire section on leprosy, expanding and completing the summary found in verse 54.
Detailed instructions on how to identify and handle various forms of skin diseases (nega hatsara'at) referred to in verse 14:54.
Specific laws concerning netek (scall or ringworm on the head or beard), which are directly mentioned in 14:54.
Refers to the requirement that lepers be sent outside the camp, illustrating the practical application of the laws in Leviticus 13–14.
An exhortation to carefully follow the priests' instructions regarding leprosy, with reference to the laws given in Leviticus.
